shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures against a plain ground
registers or horizontal banding of motifs
repeated row of similar elements across the top
justification: Both surfaces present low-relief silhouetted forms organised into horizontal registers, with a repeated row of similar motifs along the upper edge, but the actual subject matter differs sharply: A shows a menagerie of identifiable profile animals (quadrupeds, birds, a duck-like bird, felines) plus a fringe/net band, while B shows dense fields of small repeated signs, rosette-like blossoms, a large hand and drapery-like folds. Beyond the generic conventions of banded relief and profile forms, there is no shared specific motif or relationship.
